name: errors
description: Catalog-driven AppError, Result type, retry/timeout, and a PII sanitizer — framework-agnostic error handling.
docs:
A typed error foundation with no runtime dependencies.

- `AppError` — catalog-driven, framework-agnostic error. `toClient()` returns a safe payload (no detail/context); `toLog()` carries the full context — run it through `sanitize` before writing. Factories: `AppError.badRequest()`, `.unauthorized()`, `.notFound()`, `.rateLimited()`, `.internal()`, etc. Extend `ErrorCatalog` per app.
- `toAppError(e)` / `isAppError(e)` — normalize any thrown value.
- `Result<T, E>` with `ok`/`err`/`tryCatch` — return errors instead of throwing.
- `retry(fn, opts)` — exponential backoff while the error is retryable; `withTimeout(promise, ms)` rejects with `TimeoutError`.
- `sanitize(value)` (from `./sanitizer`) — recursively masks sensitive keys and secrets/PII in strings; the last line of defense before values reach a log transport. Pair it with the `logger` package's `redact` option.
